words.gloss: those who have vision or knowledge

literal: Meaning-devoid [words], even by forgetfulness, will not speak, delusion-devoid, blemish-free vision-having-people.
translation: Those who possess flawless vision, free from delusion, will not speak words devoid of meaning, even by a slip of the mind.
modern: மயக்கம் நீங்கிய, குற்றமற்ற அறிவை உடையவர்கள், மறந்தும் கூடப் பயனில்லாத சொற்களைச் சொல்ல மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains that wise people with clear, flawless understanding (மாசறு காட்சியவர்) who are free from delusion (மருள்தீர்ந்த) will never utter useless or meaningless words (பொருள்தீர்ந்த). The word 'பொச்சாந்தும்' (even by forgetfulness) is crucial here; it emphasizes that their self-control and clarity of mind are so deep-rooted that they will not let a useless word slip out even accidentally or in a moment of inattention. Their speech is a direct reflection of their pure, unblemished wisdom.
